provenance: Local M1 paired matrix microbenchmarks of the retained shared-unpack kernel. Built during 0.6.0 development before the 0.6.1 package bump. Actual production kernel vs frozen original source at ef38979; not full-model or M5 throughput.

rejected_experiments.T32: no improvement overT64; head1.027x baseline vs1.145xT64
rejected_experiments.split8: 0.679/0.832/0.719x current shared16 at up/down/head; outputbitschanged but FP64/tolerancepassed; strictlyunpromoted

limitations: Microbenchmark only; no M5 or model generation claim
Timing variation visible across separate runs; withinrun ABBA comparisons primary

captures.note: One command/dispatch per sample, alternating AB/BA order, same fixture, inputs/outputs use guarded aligned 16-byte views. Independent FP64 covers 32 evenly spread rows per RHS; baseline comparison covers every output. No model throughput claim.
